format: Japanese Storm Emeralda (M6, the Japanese Delta Reign; v154): cards not yet in English, names and attack names translated from Japanese until the English cards are out. Regulation mark J = Standard.

attacks.name: Chaos Crawler
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes no damage from attacks. If any of your Pokémon used Chaos Crawler during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

abilities.name: Excite Dive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this card is in your hand and you have a Colorless Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may put this card onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Talon Hunt
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Delicious Rice Ball
cards.text: Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon. This card heals 30 more damage for each Delicious Rice Ball in your discard pile (not counting this card).

cards.name: Mega Rayquaza Cap

attacks.name: Delta Gift
attacks.text: For each of your Pokémon that has a Mega Rayquaza Cap attached, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
